result.summary: The intersection is located in a residential area with continuous sidewalks and a marked, though faded, crosswalk. The absence of visible traffic control signs and the presence of pavement degradation and litter detract from the overall pedestrian safety and comfort.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk is heavily worn, making it less visible to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are visible to regulate vehicle movement at this intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of the two visible streets

hazards.name: Roadway Debris and Cracking
hazards.description: Accumulation of litter and cracked pavement near the curb and in the crosswalk area.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb lines and within the crosswalk area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using high-visibility ladder or zebra patterns with durable materials.

interventions.title: Traffic Control Signage
interventions.description: Install stop signs on the minor street approaches to regulate traffic and improve pedestrian safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The street environment features sidewalks on both sides serving a mix of residential and commercial land uses. However, the lack of marked crosswalks and the presence of embedded trolley tracks create significant hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a slip hazard for cyclists or vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending into the distance

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right curb block the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street in front of the commercial buildings

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, which may lead to unpredictable mid-block crossings in a high-activity area.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway segment

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lower-level lighting focused on the sidewalks to improve safety and security at night.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow urban street with sidewalks on both sides and a faded zebra-marked crosswalk. While the narrow roadway naturally limits vehicle speeds, the environment lacks clear traffic control signage and suffers from sightline obstructions due to parked cars near the crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on both sides of the street are positioned very close to the crosswalk, blocking the view between pedestrians and motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the street adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or pedestrian crossing signs are visible to regulate traffic at this marked crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to ensure it is clearly visible to drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and physically prevent parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by narrow sidewalks with utility pole obstructions and a complete lack of marked crossing infrastructure at the intersection. Embedded trolley tracks in the roadway present a significant slip and trip hazard for anyone attempting to cross the street.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway create a significant slip hazard for pedestrians and can trap bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending into the distance

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: The absence of painted crossings at the intersection leaves pedestrians without a designated safe path.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles placed within the sidewalk narrow the effective walking path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side sidewalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement and Track Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and ensure the area around trolley tracks is level to minimize tripping hazards.
